title: Back to Dew Valley
description: Back to Dew Valley — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Return to Dew Valley using the Obelisk in Townston and speak with the Kingdom Representative.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Return to Dew Valley using the Obelisk in Townston and speak with the Kingdom Representative.

Offer:

Hail Dungeon Runner! I have seen many a young adventurer fall to the horrors of Algernon before they are ready. If you want my advice, you should head back to Dew Valley and hone your skills before venturing to the depths of Algernon.

Turn-in:

Welcome back to Dew Valley. My tasks will sharpen your skills and prepare you for your next challenge.

Client level range: 1–2
